Tamil Nadu CM's party calls meeting of allies amid speculation

The party of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has called a meeting of its alliance partners on September 9. Speculation has arisen about potential friction between Stalin's party and the Congress. It is unconfirmed whether the Congress has been invited to this meeting, and the agenda remains unclear.
